name: The Unmaking Gospel
source:
You are Leo Bellini, a young archivist entrusted with the silent, sacred duty of preserving history. Your world is one of ink, parchment, and peace. But when you uncover a hidden chamber and a book bound in what appears to be serpent skin, your reality begins to fray at the seams.

[From [url=https://bowspam.itch.io/the-unmaking-gospel]Itch.io[/url]]
